reviewedBy: lane B, 26 Sep 2026: CCC 'A guide to preparing an Alcohol Management Plan (AMP) for special events' (March 2018)

items.text: Documents who is in charge of the event and each area of responsibility
items.sourceQuote: Event organisers need to establish and provide a chain of command, documenting who is in charge of the overall event and specific areas of responsibility.

items.text: Defines the type of event and its risks
items.sourceQuote: it is beneficial to define the type of event you’re running and note the risks that can be associated with the event

items.text: Pre-event communication covers intoxication, alcohol restrictions, age limits and behaviour
items.sourceQuote: Explicit information regarding the legal requirements to exclude or remove intoxicated patrons.

items.text: Sets procedures to monitor patrons and prevent intoxication
items.sourceQuote: Ensure organisers and staff proactively monitor patrons for intoxication throughout the event

items.text: Identifies a safe place for intoxicated patrons
items.sourceQuote: Identify a “safe place” that can be used for the care and protection of an intoxicated patron

items.text: Names who keeps food available while alcohol is sold
items.sourceQuote: food must be conveniently available for consumption on the premises at all times alcohol is available for purchase.

items.text: Keeps a reasonable range of low and non-alcohol drinks available at all times
items.sourceQuote: It is a condition of all special licences that a reasonable range of non alcohol and low alcohol beverages be available at all times

items.text: Free water is readily available and promoted
items.sourceQuote: free water will be readily available at all times throughout the duration of the event

items.text: Sets ID checks for anyone appearing under 25
items.sourceQuote: Set procedures to verify the age of any person appearing to be under 25 years of age

items.text: Licence displayed and prohibited-person signage at each point of sale
items.sourceQuote: “Prohibited person signage” to be displayed adjacent to points of sale.

items.text: Lists safe transport options and how they are promoted
items.sourceQuote: List the safe transport options available from your premises.

items.text: Promotions do not encourage excessive drinking
items.sourceQuote: Detail the management systems for promotions that will ensure that they do not lead to excessive consumption.

items.text: All staff are trained and briefed before the event
items.sourceQuote: It is an expectation that all staff receive appropriate training and briefing prior to the event.

items.text: Keeps an incident and noting book
items.sourceQuote: It is recognised good practice to operate an incident and noting book.
if the event numbers exceed 100 patrons (subject to the nature of the event), security staff should be employed.
Ensure adequate toilet facilities are available throughout the event.
